		data = value
		
		prevmode = -1
		prevstart = 0
		prevtime = 0
		events=[]
		paso = {0:"sin programa", 1:"hold", 2:"curado", 3:"rampa 1", 4:"secado 1", 5:"ramapa 2", 6:"secado 2", 7:"rampa 3", 8:"secado 3", 9:"enfriamiento"}
		color = {0:"#FFFFFF", 1:"#AAAAAA", 2:"#FF4747", 3:"#FFAC47", 4:"#FFFF47", 5:"#47FF47", 6:"#47FFFF", 7:"#4747FF", 8:"#FF47FF", 9:"#FF8A8A"}
		for column in range(1,data.getColumnCount()):
			tag_name = data.getColumnName(column)
			
			for row in range(data.getRowCount()):
				mode = data.getValueAt(row,column)
				time =  system.date.toMillis(data.getValueAt(row,0))
				
				if row == 0:
					prevmode = mode
					prevstart =  system.date.toMillis(start)
					
				if (mode != prevmode or row==data.getRowCount() -1) and time != prevtime:
						fromDate = system.date.fromMillis(prevstart)
						toDate = system.date.fromMillis(time)
						totalTimeInSeconds = (toDate.getTime() - fromDate.getTime()) / 1000
						if totalTimeInSeconds >=0:
						 hours, remainder = divmod(totalTimeInSeconds, 3600)
						 minutes, seconds = divmod(remainder, 60)
						 totalTime = "{:02}:{:02}:{:02}".format(int(hours), int(minutes), int(seconds))
						 events.append({
							"paso": paso[prevmode],
							"fromDate": system.date.format(fromDate, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),#system.date.format(system.date.fromMillis(prevstart), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),prevstart,
							"toDate": system.date.format(toDate, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),#system.date.format(system.date.fromMillis(time), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),time,
							"name": tag_name,
							"TotalTime": totalTime,
							"color": color[prevmode]
						})
						prevmode = mode
						prevstart = time
				prevtime = time
		return events
